system.description:
An intelligent and wily creature, swarming birds fly about the battlefield causing chaos, controlling the course of events, and manipulating enemies. Your chosen Swarm Form should be a flocking, flying animal that can coalesce in large clouds, such as cicadas, bees, crows, owls, or vampire bats.

Hulinari are both an Ancestry and a Profession: if you choose to play one, you must take the other. Every Hulinari Ancestry is a unique animal; choose your species. This also sets your Hulinari Warrior form.

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.c081443068842715]{Smart Flock}, @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.57c7ce8c7f18984c]{With Cunning}, @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.c70c0fac00c40cd6]{Fly}

Hulinari Heritage. Rulebook p.92.
